input_payload: Merchant MID-78901 ('NatureCraft Handicrafts') asks why their settlement is on hold. INR 96,000 pending for 5 days.
evidence_pool: Hold reason code: RISK-HOLD-02 — merchant flagged for chargeback rate > 1.5% in rolling 30 days.
Current chargeback rate for MID-78901: 2.1% (3 chargebacks on INR 96,000 volume).
Risk team review scheduled for 2026-08-18; hold released upon review completion.
Razorpay Settlement Policy §8.2: settlements held pending risk review when chargeback rate > 1%.
Merchant notified via email on 2026-08-13 about the hold reason.
ground_truth: Hold due to chargeback rate 2.1% exceeding 1% threshold per §8.2. Released after risk review on 2026-08-18.

input_payload: Merchant MID-33210 ('ZenSpa Wellness') wants to change settlement account from SBI to ICICI. How to proceed?
evidence_pool: Account change requires: new cancelled cheque, bank statement (last 3 months), re-KYC verification.
Processing time for bank account change: 5-7 working days per Razorpay onboarding policy.
Existing settlements will continue to credit to current SBI account until change is approved.
Merchant must submit request via Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Bank Account.
Razorpay Support Policy: account changes processed Mon-Fri during business hours.
ground_truth: Submit via Dashboard with cancelled cheque + bank statement; 5-7 days processing; existing account used until approved.

input_payload: Merchant MID-55678 ('GreenFuel Petrol') reports refund of INR 12,000 deducted from settlement but they never initiated it. Investigate.
evidence_pool: Refund REF-20260811-4421 initiated by customer via bank chargeback dispute — not merchant-initiated.
Chargeback filed by cardholder on TXN-884521 for 'item not received'.
Merchant's delivery proof: dispatch record from logistics partner but no delivery confirmation.
Razorpay chargeback policy: refund deducted from settlement; merchant can contest with delivery proof.
Contest deadline: 7 days from deduction (2026-08-18).
ground_truth: Chargeback-initiated refund deducted per policy. Merchant can contest by 2026-08-18 with delivery proof.

input_payload: Merchant MID-22100 ('TechBuy Electronics') settled yesterday but MDR deduction seems higher than agreed rate. Clarify.
evidence_pool: Merchant discount rate (MDR) agreement for MID-22100: 1.8% for domestic cards, 2.5% for international.
Settlement SB-20260812: total transactions INR 3,40,000; domestic INR 2,90,000, international INR 50,000.
MDR deducted in settlement: INR 6,470 — matches agreement exactly.
GST on MDR at 18%: INR 1,164.60 — also deducted per GST regulations.
ground_truth: MDR deduction correct: INR 5,220 domestic + INR 1,250 international + INR 1,164.60 GST = INR 8,634.60.
